resolution: Unreleased source changes require Host preview.127; the linked preview.18 manifest describes the previous published bundle and does not certify this candidate. A future detached release asset must resolve exact tagged source commits, Host image digest and asset SHA256 values after packaging. This source template does not certify publication or contain its own archive checksum.

email.kit_compatibility: App alpha.39 supports the app-owned background_refresh_description field, requiring Host preview.127 or newer. Runtime alpha.35 keeps its existing transport contracts; schema120 is unchanged. The Kit versions need not match.

supported_environment.runtime_platform: POSIX with durable private storage and HTTPS

limitations: Operator-managed developer preview, not production Gmail/Outlook parity.
Refresh can take tens of seconds; repeated latency campaigns are outside release acceptance.
OAuth configuration, purpose-specific Host gates/keys, reviewed grants and durable Runtime custody are required.
Resource publication for Task/Knowledge integration needs separate reviewed finite or explicitly Host-issued until_revoked consent; technical renewal alone does not grant it.
